function: Learns BS beamforming and artificial-noise vectors, RIS phase shifts and horizontal position, and an initial transmit phase, maximizing secure BER-gap energy efficiency (BGEE) (p. 3, 7).
system: MISO downlink: Nt-antenna Alice, single-antenna Bob and Eve, passive reflecting RIS with N units on a UAV; 5.9 GHz, 10 MHz (p. 4, 9).
method: Constraint-optimized PPO (COPPO-IPARISS): actor-critic deep reinforcement learning with a Lagrangian penalty term; fully connected networks, one 30-neuron hidden layer (p. 8, 9).
data_channel: Own simulator: path loss and Rician fading (K_ab = K_ae = 0, K_ar infinite), outdated-CSI correlation, 3D geometry; no dataset or measurement (p. 4, 5, 9).
test_conditions: Same simulated 3D scene for training and evaluation; sweeps of speed (60-120 km/h), N, Nt, Ptot, RIS height and CSI error; no separate test scenario (p. 10-13).
baselines: Learned: PPO-IPARISS (no constraint term), PPO-RAIL (RIS only), DDPG-IPARISS; non-learned: genetic algorithm GA-IPARISS (p. 9).
metrics: Average reward, BGEE (BER gap per transmit power), BER of Bob and Eve, transmit power consumption (p. 9-12).
q1_support: p. 4: "we consider path loss model and small-scale fading with Rician fading for all involved"; the K factors are set by hand on p. 9. Custom simulator; no 3GPP model, public ray-tracing set or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 12: "the impact of vehicle speeds on the BER of Bob is analyzed"; speed, N, Nt, Ptot, RIS height and CSI error are swept, but the paper never states that a model trained in one setting is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 9: "converges to 0.18 in our proposed algorithm, which is higher than PPO-IPARISS with 0.14, PPO-RAIL with 0.13, GA-IPARISS with 0.04 and DDPG-IPARISS with 0.01"; GA is the non-learned baseline, DDPG the standard learned one.
q4_support: p. 9: "Each neural network contains one hidden layer with the number of neurons 30"; architecture only. No complexity order, operation count, parameter count or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 9: "we implemented the COPPO-IPARISS optimization algorithm in Python with Pytorch 1.1 framework"; no code or data link, and no public dataset, since the channels come from the paper's own simulator.
notes: Included as area 3: the learned agent sets the BS beamformer and the RIS phases (plus artificial noise, RIS position and an initial phase) (p. 7), but the objective is physical-layer security (BGEE); the reviewer should confirm that secrecy is not an excluded function. Table I (p. 9) read from the page image. Complexity: only the network size is given. q3: DDPG-IPARISS cites an earlier DRL scheme of the same authors [62] (p. 9).
